panels.title: In one sentence
panels.description:
This VA's conversations over the last 30 days against the 30 before, its containment (per VA only), and the newest scored day against its own normal.

**Source:** n360.v_va_change, n360.v_va_day_anomaly  
**Filter:** VA  
**Window:** the 60 days to the data-through day

targets.rawSql:
SELECT concat(c.va, ': ', if(c.convs_30 IS NULL, 'conversations not reported for every day of the last 30',
                      concat(if(c.convs_30 IS NULL, NULL, if(c.convs_30 >= 1000000, concat(toString(intDiv(c.convs_30, 1000000)), ',', leftPad(toString(intDiv(c.convs_30, 1000) % 1000), 3, '0'), ',', leftPad(toString(c.convs_30 % 1000), 3, '0')), if(c.convs_30 >= 1000, concat(toString(intDiv(c.convs_30, 1000)), ',', leftPad(toString(c.convs_30 % 1000), 3, '0')), toString(c.convs_30)))), ' conversations in 30 days',
                             if(c.convs_change_pct IS NULL, '', concat(' (', if(c.convs_change_pct >= 0, '+', ''),
                                toString(round(c.convs_change_pct)), '% on the 30 before)')))),
                      ' · containment ', if(c.containment_30 IS NULL, 'not reported (no handoff data)',
                                            concat(toString(round(c.containment_30)), '%')),
                      ' · newest scored day: ', ifNull(a.k, 'not scored')) AS sentence
        FROM n360.v_va_change AS c
        LEFT JOIN (SELECT bot_id, toNullable(concat(argMax(kind, day), if(argMax(provisional, day), ' (provisional)', ''))) AS k
                   FROM n360.v_va_day_anomaly GROUP BY bot_id) AS a ON a.bot_id = c.bot_id
        WHERE toString(c.bot_id) IN (${va:singlequote})

panels.title: Data
panels.description:
The last day of usage in this load, and the day it was loaded. Amber when the data is more than 2 days old (n360.settings stamp_stale_days): the numbers are the last good night's. Click for Pipeline health.

**Source:** n360.v_freshness (n360.runs: loaded runs only)  
**Filter:** none  
**Window:** the latest load

targets.rawSql: SELECT concat(stamp, if(stale, concat(' · ', toString(days_old), ' days old'), '')) AS stamp FROM n360.v_freshness

panels.title: Status
panels.description:
The newest scored day for this VA. Provisional (newest 3 days) may still change. "Not scored": the VA has under 8 weeks of history or under 20 conversations on a typical weekday.

**Source:** n360.v_va_day_anomaly  
**Filter:** VA  
**Window:** the newest scored day

targets.rawSql:
SELECT if(count() = 0, 'Not scored',
                  if(argMax(kind, day) = 'normal', 'Normal',
                     concat(multiIf(argMax(kind, day) = 'went silent', 'Went silent', argMax(kind, day) = 'drop', 'Drop', 'Spike'),
                            if(argMax(provisional, day), ' (provisional)', '')))) AS Status
        FROM n360.v_va_day_anomaly WHERE toString(bot_id) IN (${va:singlequote})

panels.title: Last 30 days
panels.description:
Conversations started in the 30 days to the data-through day. "Not reported yet" if any day was not read.

**Source:** n360.va_day  
**Filter:** VA  
**Window:** the 30 days to the data-through day

targets.rawSql:
SELECT if(countIf(conversations IS NULL) > 0, NULL, sum(conversations)) AS Conversations
        FROM n360.va_day WHERE toString(bot_id) IN (${va:singlequote}) AND day > (SELECT toDate(max(window_end)) FROM n360.runs WHERE status = 'loaded') - 30

panels.title: Expected
panels.description:
Expected conversations for the newest scored day: the median of the same weekday over the previous 8 weeks.

**Source:** n360.v_va_day_anomaly  
**Filter:** VA  
**Window:** previous 8 weeks, same weekday

targets.rawSql: SELECT argMax(expected, day) AS Expected FROM n360.v_va_day_anomaly WHERE toString(bot_id) IN (${va:singlequote})

panels.title: Containment
panels.description:
1 - handoffs / engaged, for this VA only. "Not reported yet" where handoffs are not read.

**Source:** n360.va_day  
**Filter:** VA  
**Window:** the 30 days to the data-through day

targets.rawSql:
SELECT if(countIf(handoffs IS NOT NULL) = 0, NULL,
                  1 - sumIf(handoffs, handoffs IS NOT NULL) / sumIf(engaged, handoffs IS NOT NULL)) AS Containment
        FROM n360.va_day WHERE toString(bot_id) IN (${va:singlequote}) AND day > (SELECT toDate(max(window_end)) FROM n360.runs WHERE status = 'loaded') - 30

panels.title: Daily conversations against the expected range
panels.description:
Each day's conversations (line), the expected value for that weekday (dots) and the range within which a day is not flagged (shaded: expected +/- 4 spreads). Flags: red settled, orange provisional. Days not scored have no expected value; days not read are gaps.

**Source:** n360.va_day, n360.v_va_day_anomaly  
**Filter:** VA  
**Window:** dashboard time range, daily

targets.rawSql:
SELECT toDateTime(d.day) AS time, d.conversations AS Actual, a.expected AS Expected,
               a.expected_low AS `Expected range low`, a.expected_high AS `Expected range high`,
               if(a.kind NOT IN ('normal', '') AND NOT a.provisional, d.conversations, NULL) AS `Flag (settled)`,
               if(a.kind NOT IN ('normal', '') AND a.provisional, d.conversations, NULL) AS `Flag (provisional)`
        FROM n360.va_day AS d
        LEFT JOIN n360.v_va_day_anomaly AS a ON a.bot_id = d.bot_id AND a.day = d.day
        WHERE toString(d.bot_id) IN (${va:singlequote}) AND $__dateFilter(d.day)
        ORDER BY time
        SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 1

panels.title: Flags
panels.description:
Every flagged day for this VA in the time range. Provisional days may still change.

**Source:** n360.v_va_day_anomaly  
**Filter:** VA; flagged days  
**Window:** dashboard time range

targets.rawSql:
SELECT concat(toString(toDayOfMonth(day)), ' ', formatDateTime(day, '%b %Y')) AS Day, kind AS Kind, actual AS Actual, expected AS Expected, z AS z,
               if(provisional, 'Provisional', 'Settled') AS Status
        FROM n360.v_va_day_anomaly WHERE toString(bot_id) IN (${va:singlequote}) AND kind != 'normal' AND $__dateFilter(day) ORDER BY day DESC

defaults.noValue: No flags in this time range

panels.title: Reader and configuration
panels.description:
Where this VA's counts come from, and its newest weekly configuration read (Phase 2: "Not reported yet" until that read is in the export).

**Source:** n360.va, n360.va_day, n360.v_va_config_latest  
**Filter:** VA  
**Window:** the latest load; the newest configuration read

targets.rawSql:
SELECT Item, Value FROM (
            SELECT 1 AS o, 'Reader' AS Item, toNullable(toString(consumption_source)) AS Value FROM n360.va WHERE toString(bot_id) IN (${va:singlequote})
            UNION ALL SELECT 2, 'Contract line', if(on_contract, arrayStringConcat(line_labels, ', '), 'None (unbilled VA)')
                FROM n360.va WHERE toString(bot_id) IN (${va:singlequote})
            UNION ALL SELECT 3, 'Region', toString(region) FROM n360.va WHERE toString(bot_id) IN (${va:singlequote})
            UNION ALL SELECT 4, 'Handoff data', if((SELECT countIf(handoffs IS NOT NULL) FROM n360.va_day WHERE toString(bot_id) IN (${va:singlequote})) > 0,
                'Read', 'Not read (conversation records reader): containment not reported') 
            UNION ALL SELECT 5, 'Contract start', if(contract_start IS NULL, NULL, concat(toString(toDayOfMonth(contract_start)), ' ', formatDateTime(contract_start, '%b %Y'))) FROM n360.va WHERE toString(bot_id) IN (${va:singlequote})
            UNION ALL SELECT 6, 'Engine version', (SELECT if(count() = 0, NULL, toNullable(concat(any(engine_version),
                if(any(current_engine), ' (V8 or later)', ' (older than V8)')))) FROM n360.v_va_config_latest WHERE toString(bot_id) IN (${va:singlequote}))
            UNION ALL SELECT 7, 'V8 playbooks / legacy intents', (SELECT if(count() = 0, NULL, toNullable(concat(
                toString(any(v8_playbooks)), ' / ', toString(any(legacy_intents))))) FROM n360.v_va_config_latest WHERE toString(bot_id) IN (${va:singlequote}))
            UNION ALL SELECT 8, 'MCP servers live / supervisory rules on', (SELECT if(count() = 0, NULL, toNullable(concat(
                toString(any(mcp_servers_live)), ' / ', toString(any(supervisory_rules_on))))) FROM n360.v_va_config_latest WHERE toString(bot_id) IN (${va:singlequote}))
            UNION ALL SELECT 9, 'Configuration read on', (SELECT if(count() = 0, NULL, toNullable(concat(toString(toDayOfMonth(any(snapshot_date))), ' ', formatDateTime(any(snapshot_date), '%b %Y'))))
                FROM n360.v_va_config_latest WHERE toString(bot_id) IN (${va:singlequote}))
        ) ORDER BY o
